prompt: A trading post with an automatic sorting warehouse.

card.name: Sorting House Trading Post

site.text: An ordinary trading post on level ground, compact around a central yard where carts and traders arrive.

style.text: Practical, workmanlike trading post with timber and stone, with redstone-and-hopper machinery hinted at in the warehouse; no specific theme given.

purpose.text: A trading post with an automatic sorting warehouse that receives goods and sorts them into chests by item type.

card.interpretation: A medium trading post on flat ground, with a large central warehouse that sorts goods automatically using hoppers and redstone. Around it are a trading hall, stalls, an inn, a stable, homes for workers and a gatehouse. Style was not given, so I used a plain rustic look.
assumptions: Rustic style since none was named.
Flat terrain; no particular site was described.
Location is searched for, as no spot was given.

program.notes: Intake hoppers and water-stream or minecart feed, banks of labelled item-sorter chests, overflow chests, visible redstone sorting lines. Large loading doors on the yard.
Main counter and stalls where villagers trade; stocked from the warehouse next door.
Open-fronted market stalls by the yard selling food, tools and goods.
Ledgers, maps and a lectern; the manager of the post lives upstairs.
Beds and a hearth for travelling merchants.
Horses, llamas and carts for arriving caravans.
Entry where goods are checked and tolls are taken.
